## What we do

::: {.pillars}
The Autonomy, Controls, and Robotics Engineering (ACRE) Lab is a research lab in the [Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering at NC State University](https://ece.ncsu.edu).
We use tools from control theory to build trustworthy autonomous systems. Our vision is to design algorithms for autonomous systems with goal of ensuring that such systems are:

**Safe.** Formally ensure that autonomous systems operate within strict user-defined limits, backed by rigorous mathematical guarantees.

**Reliable.** Behave as expected even in the presence of disturbances, model errors, and other sources of uncertainty.

**Performant.** Autonomous systems that are not just safe but that are also highly dynamic and efficient, capable of completing complex tasks.

[Read more about our research](research.qmd)
:::
